get_config_default: get the default training config with ResNet50 and momentum optimizer for galaxy merger model evaluation
get_config_with_time_filter: get a training config with custom time filter intervals for filtering galaxy merger data
customize_resnet_kwargs: customize the ResNet50 blocks and batch normalization settings in the experiment config

customize_data_config: customize the data config image size augmentations and loss function for galaxy merger training
